leadText:
Harrison (Japanese: ハリゾウ Harizō) is a character of the day who appeared in Dueling Heroes.

Harrison was brashly confident that he and his would defeat Misty in the first round of the Whirl Cup, citing his years of experience as a . However, Misty and her quickly defeated him and Qwilfish, allowing Misty to advance to the second round.

==Trivia==
Harrison's Japanese name is a reference to "bari", the word for "hook". When combined with the Japanese name of the episode's other character of the day, , their names make up "fishing hook".
